Buradagunta Srinivas Rao vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 6
November, 2025
Aphc010585352025
 In The High Court Of Andhra Pradesh
At Amaravati [3396]

(Special Original Jurisdiction)
 Thursday, The Sixth Day Of November
 Two Thousand And Twenty Five
 Present
The Honourable Dr Justice Venkata Jyothirmai Pratapa
 Criminal Petition No: 11356/2025
Between:
 1.

Buradagunta Srinivas Rao, S/O
 Venkateswararao,Age 40 Years, Occ Unemployed,R/O
 D.No. 11-1, Jonnalagadda Village,Guntur East
 Mandal, Guntur District.
Andhra Pradesh, Pin 522034.

...Petitioner/Accused
 And
 1.

The State Of Andhra Pradesh, Through S.H.O,
 Medikonduru P.S, Guntur District,Rep. By Its.

Public
 Prosecutor,High Court At Amaravati.

2. Buradagunta Anita, W/O Srinivasa Rao,Age 30 Years,
 Occ House Wife,Siripuram Village,
 Madikondurumandalam,Gunturdistrict, Andhra
 Pradesh-522201
 ...

Respondent/Complainant(S):
Counsel for the Petitioner/accused:
1. Chigurupati Ravindra Babu Counsel for the Respondent/complainant(S):
1. Public Prosecutor
The Court Made the Following Order:

The instant Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 of the Bnss, by the
Petitioner herein/A1, to quash the proceedings in Crime No.122 of 2022 of
Medikonduru Police Station, Guntur Urban District, registered for the offences
punishable under Sections 498A and 323 read with 34 Ipc and Sections 3 and 4 of
the Dowry Prohibition Act.

2. Heard Sri Ch.Ravindra Babu, learned counsel for the petitioner and Ms.Priyanka Lakshmi,
learned Assistant Public Prosecutor representing the respondent/State.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the petition may be disposed of by giving protection to the petitioner vide guidelines of the Hon'ble Apex Court in Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar1.

sentences.text:
4. Learned Assistant Public Prosecutor, on instructions, would submit that the offences registered against the petitioner are punishable with less than seven years period of imprisonment and necessary direction may be given to the concerned Station House Officer.
5. Considering the submissions, this criminal petition is disposed of with the following;
a. Investigating Officer is at liberty to complete the investigation, in accordance with law.
b.

In the event of any coercive action sought to be taken against the petitioner, concerned police authorities are directed to scrupulously follow the procedure prescribed under Section 35(3) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, and the guidelines laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Arnesh Kumar's case (supra).
1 (2014) 8 SCC 273 6.
It goes without saying that, if any charge sheet is filed in the above crime, the petitioner is at liberty to challenge the charge sheet, if he feels aggrieved by the same.
7. Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is disposed of.
Pending applications, if any, shall stands closed.

Dr. VENKATA JYOTHIRMAI PRATAPA, J Date: 06.11.2025 Asr THE HONOURABLE DR JUSTICE VENKATA JYOTHIRMAI PRATAPA Dt.06.11.2025 Asr Buradagunta Srinivas Rao vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/201445/
